summary_for_children: At-Tahrim tells believers to protect their families with good deeds and gives two examples of faith: the wife of Pharaoh and Maryam.
environment_concept: A palace room (66:11) and a quiet sanctuary with fruit in a lit niche (66:12). No one is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A palace interior and a modest sanctuary.

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Learning from Our Choices
story_library.children_narration: Surah At-Tahrim includes lessons about responsibility within households and examples of women who made different choices. It reminds us that every person is responsible for their own faith and actions. Maryam is presented as an example of devotion.

world_idea.title: The Gallery of Examples
world_idea.description: Discover narrated lessons through separate historical-style environments and reflect on sincerity and personal responsibility.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
